title: Ned and the Hen
note: b412 — Phase 2, 20-sound stage. Non-fiction note: a garden bird can genuinely get stuck in soft mud and need a tug free.

pages.brief: A brown hen with her feet sunk into a patch of thick mud in a garden, unable to move.
A brown hen straining and flapping, huffing with effort, stuck fast in mud.
Ned the duckling jumping up and running quickly across a garden towards a stuck hen.
Ned the duckling reaching a stuck hen, taking hold near her to help.
Ned the duckling tugging firmly, pulling a hen's foot free of mud bit by bit.
A brown hen standing free on firm ground at last, muddy feet now clear of a mud patch.
A brown hen and Ned the duckling both cheerful, walking away from a muddy patch together.
